source.method: Union only native polygon water by source lake/river/canal class in centimeter-snapped east/south coordinates;then rotate into signed model frame. Upstream lake pieces use model datum Y=0,downstream river/pockets use explicitly estimated Y=-57. Retains native shore/island holes;no full rectangular inferred water plane.

limitations: Static illustrative levels derived from the ordinary-picture layout and coarse standard terrain. Main reservoir sample1260.965851m;estimated tailwater1203.965851m. Native water pockets and operational levels are unverified;no hydrologic simulation or surveyed shoreline contact.
